_comment: Phase 15 checks of the 15 V Board P draft PCB (unvalidated draft, no layout review). DRC: native KiCad 10.0.6 kicad-cli pcb drc --severity-all --refill-zones, run as heavy-guard -> flock /tmp/kicad-native.lock, on the draft and on the unchanged as-built board for comparison. RESET scans: scripts/pcb/board-p-reset-clearance.py (same layer, and in-plane to the other copper layer with --cross-layer). Net parity: scripts/pcb/board-p15/pcb-net-parity.py against board_p15_spec.py (net-parity.json).

drc.new_warnings: R21 R0603 library silk overlaps the U1 reference field (silk_overlap, silk_over_copper); the J2.4 label now reads NC at the as-built 0.7 mm text height. No error class.

target: RESET copper at least 1.0 mm from VBUS_IN, VBUS_VS_DISCH, DISCH, VBEN, VBUS_OUT and Q1_G copper on its layer (the LED proposed 1.0 mm RESET strap keep-out; no manufacturer source)
as_built_reference: same-layer 0.222 mm (R13 pads) and 0.325 mm (VBUS_VS_DISCH via); other-layer 0.0 mm (B.Cu VBUS_OUT and VBUS_VS_DISCH tracks under the RESET track)
